title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 393 (Company's failure to comply with provisions of this Chapter not to affect validity of contracts, etc.)

content.overview: A failure by a foreign company to comply with this Chapter does not affect the validity of a contract, dealing or transaction, but the company cannot bring a suit or proceeding on it until the failure is made good.
content.glance: A failure by a foreign company to comply with this Chapter does not affect the validity of a contract, dealing or transaction, but the company cannot bring a suit or proceeding on it until the failure is made good.
